quests.title: For an Ice Mirror Fragment

dialogue.t: Hmm, there's no one in the tent, but not much snow buildup either...
Who would even come here, anyway? How strange...
What's this? An adventure notebook?
"The blizzard plastered itself to my face like a mask, almost sealing my eyes shut. I could not find the homeward way, let alone a path to the House of Hesperides..."
"Fortunately, I was able to find a cave to avoid the storm, but my stocks of food are bottoming out... Perhaps I should never have... No. No. This is a trial set before me. It must be."
"I must reach the mansion and meet the great lady... I must witness true Prime Ice artisanship."
"But how will I get out of here? Perhaps I can continue to explore this cave first..."
"Hmm. I think I've gotten used to the temperature in here. Everything's starting to warm up just a little..."
Whoa, is this person okay? Seems like he's frozen so bad, he's starting to hallucinate.

dialogue.sit: Well, he did warm up, didn't he?
The situation does seem quite serious...

dialogue.t: Come on, you know that feeling warm in a snowy place like this is the last thing you wanna have happen!
According to his notes, he's proceeding through this cave... Let's go on ahead as well. Can't be sure if he can still be saved, though...
(test)你没事吧？
(test)呜，这里的冰...
(test)要赶快离开才行
(test)噼啪
"The blizzard plastered itself to my face like a mask, almost sealing my eyes shut. I could not find the homeward way, let alone a path to the House of Hesperides..."
"Fortunately, I was able to find a cave to avoid the storm, but my stocks of food are bottoming out... Perhaps I should never have... No. No. This is a trial set before me. It must be."
"I must reach the mansion and meet the great lady... I must witness true Prime Ice artisanship."
"But how will I get out of here? Perhaps I can continue to explore this cave first..."
"Hmm. I think I've gotten used to the temperature in here. Everything's starting to warm up just a little..."
Good thing we didn't fall straight into the water...
Ohh, b—be careful... This ice block's starting to move...
Don't worry, we'll get you outta here.
*panting* ... Oh, Tsaritsa be praised... Scared me to death there... If I'd fallen into the water, that would've been the end of me.
Thanks, you two. I'm Martos... Sorry...
Why are you apologizing?
...I wanted to tell you that that block of ice wasn't at all solid, but I just... couldn't get the words out while I was up there. I can't say why.
Eh, you were probably just feeling a bit too weak, y'know? Anyway, feeling better now?
Yes, much better. Thanks to you two, to be honest... Um, might I know your names?
{NICKNAME} and Paimon... I see.
...That said, Martos, what brings you here at all, out in the ice and snow?
Prime Ice Sculpting. That's what I came here to learn...
Prime Ice Sculpting?
That's right! *cough* I was headed to the House of Hesperides. Its owner is the princess of the Snegovik, one exceedingly skilled at this art...

Many a masterpiece was created by her hand, even the snowflake at the heart of the Zapolyarny Palace plaza and the sculptures made in the likeness of crystal ores that stand before the ducal mansion of Novokitezhgrad...
Humans cannot call upon Prime Ice as the fae do... but we can learn to use hammer and chisel to bring forth similar beauty.
Thanks to you two, I'm one step closer to the mansion!
Wait, you're still going up the mountain, then?
Well, I'm here already, aren't I? It would be such a shame to turn back now...
But...

dialogue.sit: I won't stop you from continuing on, but wait for the blizzard to die down a bit.
Make sure you rest up before you leave, alright?

dialogue.t: Alright, I will.

dialogue.sit: You help him start a fire here and give him a share of your food and water.

dialogue.t: Well, you've had something to eat and drink, and you're all warmed up, too. Now you're good to go!
Th—Thank you two, truly.
If I do indeed learn this art, I will surely, surely make you a great sculpture!

dialogue.sit: Remember to make me a bit taller, eh...
Remember to make Paimon somewhat cuter...

dialogue.t: Paimon would like that too...
Hahaha, don't worry! I'm sure my work will be more than satisfactory!

quests.description: You find notes left behind by someone who was lost in the snowy mountains… Is he still alive? Is there still time for you to save his life…?
